typography.rationale: Geist delivers the ultra-clean, technical, yet premium 'Linear' feel. It eliminates the generic template look of Poppins while retaining legibility at small sizes.

mono.usage: Use strictly for the 6 memory categories tags, code snippets, timestamps, and metadata tags.

rules: No full-screen gradients. Use deep dark solid backgrounds.
Strictly ONE accent color (#3B82F6). Remove all violet/purple.
Never use pure black or pure #808080. Adhere to the provided hex scale.
Use 'hairline' borders (border-white/5 or border-[#ffffff12]) for structural separation.

surfaces.pills: bg-[#232323] hover:bg-[#2A2A2A] transition-colors border border-transparent hover:border-white/5 rounded-full

textures: Apply extremely subtle noise texture overlay (opacity 1-2%) globally to remove digital flatness.

Cards.description: Minimalist containers, never purely flat. Always include an inset shadow to simulate a 1px top highlight.

Buttons.primary: bg-blue-500 hover:bg-blue-600 text-white rounded-lg px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium transition-all shadow-[inset_0_1px_0_rgba(255,255,255,0.2)]
Buttons.secondary: bg-[#232323] hover:bg-[#2A2A2A] text-white/90 rounded-lg px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium border border-white/5 transition-all shadow-[inset_0_1px_0_rgba(255,255,255,0.02)]

Inputs.classes: bg-[#191919] border border-white/10 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-white placeholder:text-white/30 focus:outline-none focus:border-blue-500 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-blue-500/50 transition-all shadow-[inset_0_2px_4px_rgba(0,0,0,0.2)]

Tabs.description: Horizontal pill nav. Inactive tabs are text-white/50. Active tab has bg-[#232323] + text-white. Underline is a framer-motion layoutId.
Tabs.classes: relative px-3 py-1.5 text-sm font-medium rounded-md transition-colors

Memory_Rows.description: Data rows for the 6 categories. Should look like highly polished ledger entries, not Kanban tasks. Emphasize timestamps and typography over container boxes.
Memory_Rows.classes: group flex items-center justify-between py-3 border-b border-[var(--hairline)] hover:bg-[#1E1E1E]/50 transition-colors cursor-pointer

Chat_Turns.user: bg-[#2A2A2A] text-white/90 rounded-2xl rounded-tr-sm px-4 py-3 max-w-[85%] self-end
Chat_Turns.assistant: bg-transparent text-white/80 pr-4 py-3 max-w-[90%] self-start border-l-2 border-blue-500/30 pl-4

grids.marketing_bento: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-6. Hero tile spans col-span-12 lg:col-span-8. Supporting tiles span col-span-4.
grids.app_dashboard: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4 gap-4. Dense, highly optimized for scanning.

layouts.spacing: Generous spacing. Use p-8 or p-12 for major section padding. Within cards, use p-5 or p-6. Never cramp text.
layouts.sidebar: w-64 fixed left-0 top-0 h-screen bg-[#191919] border-r border-[var(--hairline)] flex flex-col z-40

motion.philosophy: Cinematic but quiet. No bouncy spring animations. Use ease-out for entrances, ease-in for exits.
motion.page_load: opacity-0 to opacity-100, translateY(10px) to translateY(0) with duration 0.4s and ease [0.22, 1, 0.36, 1].
motion.stagger: List items (Memory rows, dashboard tiles) should stagger reveal with 0.05s delay increments.
motion.interactions: Buttons scale down slightly on active (scale: 0.98). Hover states transition color in 0.15s.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text-white/50 meets 4.5:1 ratio against #191919. (Use text-white/60 if necessary).
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements MUST have a visible focus ring (focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-blue-500 focus-visible:ring-offset-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-[#191919]).
accessibility.data_testid: MANDATORY on all links, buttons, inputs, tabs, and major view containers (e.g., data-testid='nav-dashboard-link', data-testid='ask-bracket-submit').

media.images: Use monochromatic or deeply tinted images. Opacity overlays must not exceed 50%. Let the image content breathe.

3d_libraries.recommendation: Use framer-motion for 2.5D depth on marketing scroll. Avoid heavy WebGL/Three.js unless specifically building the 'Connected Sources' hero visualization.
3d_libraries.visual_data: For activity digests, use simple Recharts with custom tooltips (bg-[#1E1E1E], 1px border), matching the dark UI exactly.

image_urls.description: Minimalist dark workspace desk, to be used with a radial gradient fade for the marketing hero section.
Dimly lit workspace, perfect for the 'Late Night Sync' or 'Background Activity' bento box illustration.

client_os_vs_pm_tool.core_distinction: A PM tool requires manual task creation and status dragging. Bracket is an 'OS' that passively reads integrated apps and extracts a 'Memory'.
ui_implications: NO kanban boards. NO drag-and-drop task columns.
Use chronological 'Ledger' feeds, digest logs, and conversational UI (Ask Bracket).
Data should look 'extracted' (e.g., source tags like 'From Slack', 'From Gmail' next to memory rows).
Focus heavily on the 'Zero Connections' empty state: the OS is dead until tools are connected. This connection page is the heartbeat.
client_os_vs_pm_tool.fixed_categories: Deliverables, Scope Items, Timelines, Requirements, Decisions, Deadlines. (These act as immutable system folders/pills, NOT user-editable lists).

implementation_order.description: Implement global CSS vars, Tailwind config (Geist font, specific spacing), and the Sidebar Shell navigation.
Login (OTP + password). Crucially: 'Zero Connections' empty state and 'Connect Work' provider picker. This establishes the 'OS' paradigm.
Projects list, 5-step project composer modal, and Activity digest feed. Nail the high-density grid and staggered row animations.
The core. Horizontal pill nav for the 6 fixed categories. Highly polished ledger rows with tags. 'Ask Bracket' chat thread component alongside it.
Landing page bento grids, cinematic hero, pricing. Re-use components (buttons, pills, chat turns) from the app to show a unified 'Product-Led' marketing aesthetic.

screen_by_screen_notes.Marketing_Landing: Hero text text-6xl+ with ultra-tight tracking. Hero image uses the provided Unsplash URL behind a bg-[#191919]/60 gradient. Bento grid for features.
screen_by_screen_notes.Dashboard: No clutter. A single prominent 'Start new project' pill. Stats tiles use the inset-shadow card style. Project list uses clean table-less rows.
screen_by_screen_notes.Project_Memory: Top section: overview stats. Middle: the 6 fixed categories as a horizontally scrolling, sticky pill navigation. Below: categorized rows. Right panel: Ask Bracket.
screen_by_screen_notes.Ask_Bracket: Do not make it look like ChatGPT. Make it look like a native system terminal (inset panel, border-l border-white/5, transparent assistant background).
screen_by_screen_notes.Activity_Digest: A chronological feed. Left column: timestamps. Right column: action text with highlighted system tags (Geist Mono text-xs).
screen_by_screen_notes.Connected_Sources: Gridded display of tools (Slack, Figma, etc.). Connected tools have a glowing green status dot and 'Disconnect' hover state. Disconnected tools are grayscale.

instructions_to_main_agent: You are writing .js React 19 files, NOT .tsx. Skip TypeScript interfaces.
React Router v7 is being used. Follow v7 routing paradigms.
Configure Tailwind with custom colors mapping exactly to the provided CSS variables.
Install and use `framer-motion` for all specified staggered layouts and layoutId animations.
Install `lucide-react` for standard UI icons and `@phosphor-icons/react` (duotone) for marketing/bento illustrations.
Never use fully transparent backgrounds for sticky headers or dropdowns. ALWAYS use `bg-[#191919]/80 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-white/5`.
Add `data-testid` to EVERYTHING that can be clicked or contains key data.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do NOT use 'Inter' for headings. Adhere strictly to the Geist Sans / Geist Mono recommendation for the Linear/Vercel aesthetic.
Ensure 'hairline' borders (border-white/5) are used to separate panels, never heavy shadows on dark mode.
No generic centered layouts. Use asymmetrical bento grids for marketing, and strict high-density grids for the dashboard.
Use 2-3x more spacing (p-8, p-12) than standard Tailwind defaults.
Maintain the single accent color (#3B82F6) for primary actions. Let the UI breathe in monochrome everywhere else.
